100	# counting the owner twice.

102	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerHouseholdSize
103	  govern: [ transaction ]

107	# (case-insensitively) before this create. Reads the count in the same transaction as the

111	  govern: [ transaction ]
